an4.220:1.1: catūhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye.
an4.220:1.3: assaddho hoti. dussīlo hoti. kusīto hoti. duppañño hoti.
an4.220:1.4: imehi kho bhikkhave catuhi dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ nirayeti.
an4.220:2.1: catuhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ sagge.
an4.220:2.3: saddho hoti. sīlavā hoti. āraddhaviriyo hoti. paññavā hoti.
an4.220:2.4: imehi kho bhikkhave catūhi dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ saggeti.
